desc: TriStar's TT-15 is a dedicated trap gun which offers precision, beauty and performance. It is loaded with features; including a raised target rib with 3 adjustment points, adjustable comb, palm swell, fiber optic sight and color coded extended Beretta/Benelli Mobil chokes. This Combo Trap model features a 32" (Over/Under) and 34"(Unsingle) adjustable vent rib barrel.
